arithmetic_policy: Only totals, ranges, means, differences and ratios of recorded values; no new cryptographic evaluation or trial, no inferential test. Per-curve observations remain clustered.

D.description: Deterministic bit-gate scalar and fixed-window instrumentation completed on all eight fixtures.
D.mismatch_reporting: No discrepancy is reported in the completed rows; no separate numerical mismatch counter is emitted.
limits: The circuit is forward computation plus exhaustive checks, not a new inverse evaluator.
All rows record new_cancellation_rule=false and solver_gain_claim=false.

L1.description: Computable Teichmuller/Hensel section profiles, exact additivity defects, and one fixed predictor were measured.
limits: The predictor is fixed and in-sample; zero and the sign/base-point labels are controlled explicitly.
Each score is within its own recorded 99-null range; this is a descriptive comparison, not a significance test.
One section/predictor, no decoder or scalar-recovery cost advantage.

L2.description: Known EDS/coordinate checks and a finite 15-monomial quadratic predictor were measured.
limits: Only finite prefixes and the declared quadratic grammar were tested.
Small-case consistent fits are underidentified; infinity-crossing exclusions are recorded.
No nonlinear index locator or scalar decoder is constructed.

L3.description: Known negation and separately stratified j=0 scalar actions were checked.
limits: Every recorded witness retains all r compatible scalars.
Eigenvalue lookup is explicitly enumerative; no new coordinate observable is supplied.

L4.description: The complete finite common rational basis grammar was searched.
limits: All 48 invertible matrices fail first at AND in this grammar only.
No statement about all rational bases, per-wire bases, alternate encodings, or all matchgate approaches.
No global planar solver was constructed.

L5.description: Known Boolean branch/CRT and target-pinning controls completed.
limits: Lost-label total is summed across overlapping depths, not a count of distinct scalars.
The original deferred quotient solver was not executed; no target-local constructive invariant was supplied.

L6.description: Periodic bounded-depth residual vectors and their complete scalar dictionaries were enumerated.
limits: State counts come from charged full enumeration, not a cheap uniform constructor.
Every x-projection retains maximum ambiguity two; target orientation and decoding remain absent.

L7.description: Explicit truth tables and independent F2 Mobius coefficients agree for all recorded target prefixes.
limits: A full charged truth table is constructed for every target.
These observations share truth tables with L8 and are not independent confirmation.
No cheap coefficient evaluator was obtained.

L8.description: Truth-derived Fp polynomial/count and divisibility receipt controls completed.
limits: The explicit encoding is a truth-derived multilinear indicator, not a gate-polynomial compiler.
The lower divisibility bound is zero on these systems; the counts are obtained by enumeration.
No exact-residue constructor or new solver is supplied.

L9.description: The full finite pair histogram panel was measured with unconditional and, where applicable, sign-pair matched relabeling references.
limits: These are exhaustive finite distributions with numerical log2 evaluation; relabeling means use 99 recorded draws.
Both full-point and constant controls have zero conditional entropy, so entropy alone is not a scalar-recovery criterion.
Primary-reference gaps across a 22-member exploratory panel are descriptive; no multiple-testing or significance claim is made.
No propagation algorithm or scalar-recovery decoder was run.
